# NIMH MonkeyLogic

> > NIMH MonkeyLogic is a MATLAB-based software toolkit developed by the National Institute of Mental Health for behavioral control and data acquisition in neuroscience research.

MonkeyLogic provides researchers with tools for designing and running behavioral experiments, particularly for primate neuroscience studies. The platform requires MATLAB and various system dependencies including Visual C++ redistributables and DirectX runtime components for Windows-based experimental setups.
